title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 2: the mountain of Yahweh's house, swords into plowshares, and the day against all that is proud.

questions.text: What shall be established on the top of the mountains in the latter days?
questions.explanation: The text says that in the latter days the mountain of Yahweh's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and all nations shall flow to it.

questions.text: The law shall go out of Zion, and what shall go from Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The peoples say the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh's word from Jerusalem.

questions.text: Into what shall the peoples beat their spears?
questions.explanation: They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks.

questions.text: What will the nations no longer learn when Yahweh judges between them?
questions.explanation: The text says nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

questions.text: What do the people whose land is full of idols worship?
questions.explanation: Their land is full of idols, and they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

answers.text: The work of their own hands

questions.text: From what are people told to hide when they enter into the rock and the dust?
questions.explanation: They are told to enter into the rock and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh and from the glory of his majesty.

questions.text: Against what will the day of Yahweh of Armies come?
questions.explanation: There will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low.

answers.text: All that is weak and lowly
All the nations of the east
All that is proud and arrogant

questions.text: The day of Yahweh is for all the cedars of Lebanon and for all the oaks of which place?
questions.explanation: It is for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and for all the oaks of Bashan.

questions.text: To what will men cast away their idols of silver and gold in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold to the moles and to the bats.

answers.text: To the moles and to the bats
Into the depths of the sea
To the beggars at the gates

questions.text: The chapter ends by saying to stop trusting in man, whose breath is where?
questions.explanation: The last verse says, "Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?"
